AREV.justification: The return signal of human prayer or query back to the source.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-authenticating identity of the divine transmitter.

phase_3.true_description: Clear prophetic reception and actionable divine insight.

steps.domain_action: The Ein Sof initiates a pulse within the vacuum.
The pulse identifies itself as the primordial Word.
The signal descends through the first triad of emanations.
The signal divides into the polarities of Mercy and Severity.
The Mercy branch expands to encompass all potential outcomes.
The Severity branch restricts the signal to specific parameters.
Tiferet harmonizes the expansion and restriction into a balanced decree.
The balanced decree chains into the lower emotional sefirot.
The signal enters the state of Da'at, holding all contradictions.
The human receiver sends a verification query back up the chain.
The completed exchange is etched into the permanent Akashic Ledger.
The communication grounds in the physical world as a realized event.
